articles.title_en: Competitive and revenue‐optimal pricing with budgets
articles.title_cn: 预算下的竞争性与收入最优定价
articles.abstract_en: In markets with budget‐constrained buyers, competitive equilibria need not be efficient in the utilitarian sense or maximize the seller's revenue. We consider a setting with multiple divisible goods. Competitive equilibrium outcomes, and only those, are constrained utilitarian efficient, a notion of utilitarian efficiency that respects buyers' demands and budgets. Our main contribution establishes that when buyers have linear valuations, competitive equilibrium prices are unique and revenue‐optimal for a zero‐cost seller.
articles.abstract_cn: 在预算受限的买家市场中，竞争均衡在功利意义上不必是有效的，也不一定能最大化卖方的收入。我们考虑一个具有多种可分商品的设定。竞争均衡结果，且仅有这些结果，是受约束的功利有效的——这是一种尊重买家需求和预算的功利效率概念。我们的主要贡献在于，当买家具有线性估值时，竞争均衡价格是唯一的，并且对零成本卖方而言是收入最优的。

articles.title_en: Commonality of information and commonality of beliefs
articles.title_cn: 信息的共同性与信念的共同性
articles.abstract_en: A group of agents with a common prior receive informative signals about an unknown state repeatedly over time. If these signals were public, agents' beliefs would be identical and commonly known. This suggests that if signals were private, then the more correlated they are, the greater is the commonality of beliefs. We show that, in fact, the opposite may be true. In the long run, conditionally independent signals may achieve greater commonality of beliefs than correlated signals.
articles.abstract_cn: 一群具有共同先验的代理人随时间重复接收关于未知状态的信息性信号。如果这些信号是公开的，代理人的信念将是相同的且为共同知识。这表明如果信号是私人的，那么它们相关性越强，信念的共同性就越大。我们表明，事实上，情况可能相反。在长期中，条件独立信号可能比相关信号实现更大的信念共同性。

articles.abstract_en: We study project selection and development by a principal, interacting with two agents, each of whom wants his respective project selected. When the best choice is uncertain, keeping both projects alive gives the principal the ability to adapt her choice in the future, but implies an efficiency loss of effort being spent on the project finally not chosen. We show that a time‐varying threshold rule is uniquely optimal: the principal selects the first project to achieve a sufficient lead. The optimum entails initial competition, always followed by permanent collaboration. Our proof uses martingale time‐change methods that apply weak solutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个委托人与两个代理人互动时的项目选择与开发问题，每个代理人都希望自己的项目被选中。当最佳选择不确定时，让两个项目都保持存活使委托人能够在未来调整她的选择，但意味着投入在最终未被选择的项目上的努力会造成效率损失。我们证明，一个随时间变化的阈值规则是唯一最优的：委托人选择第一个取得足够领先的项目。最优状态涉及初始竞争，随后总是永久合作。我们的证明使用了应用于弱解的鞅时间变换方法。

articles.title_en: Evidence and skepticism in verifiable disclosure games
articles.title_cn: 可验证披露博弈中的证据与怀疑
articles.abstract_en: A key feature of communication with evidence is skepticism: a receiver will attribute any incomplete disclosure to the sender concealing unfavorable evidence. I study when a change in the receiver"s prior belief about the sender's evidence induces more skepticism, i.e., induces the receiver, regardless of his preferences, to take an equilibrium action that is less favorable for the sender following every message. I provide a definition of when one receiver's prior belief expects more evidence than another and show that this characterizes more skepticism. As an input, I fully characterize receiver optimal equilibrium outcomes in general verifiable disclosure games.
articles.abstract_cn: 带有证据的沟通的一个关键特征是怀疑：接收者会将任何不完整的披露归因于发送者隐瞒不利证据。我研究了接收者关于发送者证据的先验信念何时发生变化会引发更多怀疑，即无论接收者的偏好如何，都会在每条信息之后采取对发送者较不利的均衡行动。我给出了一个定义，说明一个接收者的先验信念何时比另一个预期更多证据，并证明这表征了更多的怀疑。作为输入，我完整刻画了一般可验证披露博弈中接收者最优的均衡结果。

articles.title_cn: 机制设计中的概率验证
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a model of probabilistic verification in mechanism design. The principal elicits a message from the agent and then selects a test to give the agent. The agent's true type determines the probability with which he can pass each test. We characterize whether each type has an associated test that best screens out all other types. If this condition holds, then the testing technology can be represented in a tractable reduced form. We use this reduced form to solve for profit‐maximizing mechanisms with verification. As the verification technology varies, the solution continuously interpolates between the no‐verification solution and full surplus extraction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在机制设计中引入了一个概率验证模型。委托人从代理人处 elicits 一条消息，然后选择一个测试给代理人。代理人的真实类型决定了他能通过每个测试的概率。我们刻画了每种类型是否具有一个相关联的测试，能最好地将所有其他类型甄别出来。如果这一条件成立，那么测试技术就可以用一种易于处理的简约形式来表示。我们利用这一简约形式来求解带验证的利润最大化机制。随着验证技术的变化，解在无验证解与完全剩余抽取之间连续插值。

articles.abstract_en: Implementation theory is concerned with the existence of mechanisms in which, at each state of the world, all equilibria result in outcomes that are within a given social choice correspondence (SCC). However, if agents make mistakes, if their preferences or the solution concept are misspecified, or if the designer is limited in what can be used as punishments, then it may be desirable to insist that also deviations result in “acceptable” outcomes. Safe implementation adds this extra requirement to standard implementation. Our primitives, therefore, also include an acceptability correspondence, which, like the SCC, maps states of the world to sets of allocations. When the underlying solution concept is Nash equilibrium, we identify necessary and sufficient conditions (namely, comonotonicity and safe no‐veto) that restrict the joint behavior of the SCC and of the acceptability correspondence, and that generalize Maskin's (1999) conditions. In relevant economic applications, these conditions can be quite permissive, but in “rich” preference domains, safe implementation is impossible, regardless of the solution concept.
articles.abstract_cn: 实施理论研究的是机制的存在性，在这种机制中，在世界的每一个状态下，所有均衡结果都落在给定的社会选择对应（SCC）之内。然而，如果行为人会犯错，如果他们的偏好或解概念被错误设定，或者如果设计者在可用作惩罚的手段上受到限制，那么可能有必要坚持偏离也产生“可接受的”结果。安全实施在标准实施之上增加了这一额外要求。因此，我们的原始设定还包括一个可接受性对应，它像SCC一样，将世界状态映射到配置集合。当基础解概念是纳什均衡时，我们识别了限制SCC与可接受性对应联合行为的必要且充分条件（即共单调性和安全无否决权），这些条件推广了Maskin（1999）的条件。在相关的经济应用中，这些条件可以相当宽松，但在“丰富”的偏好域中，无论解概念如何，安全实施都是不可能的。

articles.abstract_en: How best to incentivize prompt disclosure? We study this question in a general model in which a technological breakthrough occurs at an uncertain time and is privately observed by an agent, and a principal must incentivize disclosure via her control of a payoff‐relevant physical allocation. We uncover a deadline structure of optimal mechanisms: they have a simple deadline form in an important special case, and a graduated deadline structure in general. We apply our results to the design of unemployment insurance schemes.
articles.abstract_cn: 如何最好地激励及时披露？我们在一个一般模型中研究这个问题，其中技术突破在不确定的时间发生，并被代理人私下观察到，而委托人必须通过其对与收益相关的实物配置的控制来激励披露。我们揭示了最优机制的截止期限结构：它们在一个重要的特例中具有简单的截止期限形式，在一般情况下具有渐进式截止期限结构。我们将我们的结果应用于失业保险方案的设计。

articles.title_en: Ex post approaches to prioritarianism and sufficientarianism
articles.title_cn: 优先主义与充分主义的事后方法
articles.abstract_en: Although sufficientarianism has been gaining interest as a theory of distributive justice in recent years, it has not been examined in the presence of risk. We propose an ex post approach to sufficientarianism that has a strong link to ex post prioritarianism. Both ex post criteria are based on an axiom that we refer to as prospect independence of the unconcerned, a natural extension of the independence axiom known from the literature that focuses on situations with no risk. We characterize a class of ex post prioritarian orderings as well as the corresponding class of ex post sufficientarian orderings. In addition, we point out some important differences between these two ex post criteria, and we examine how they fare when assessed in terms of specific ex ante Paretian axioms.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管近年来充分主义作为分配正义理论越来越受到关注，但尚未在有风险的情况下得到检验。我们提出一种事后充分主义方法，它与事后优先主义有密切联系。这两个事后标准都基于一个我们称之为“无关者前景独立性”的公理，它是文献中已知的独立性公理的自然扩展，该公理关注无风险情形。我们刻画了一类事后优先主义排序以及相应的一类事后充分主义排序。此外，我们指出了这两个事后标准之间的一些重要差异，并考察了它们在特定事前帕累托公理下的表现。

articles.title_en: Existence of a non‐stationary equilibrium in search‐and‐matching models: TU and NTU
articles.title_cn: 搜索匹配模型中非平稳均衡的存在性：可转移效用与不可转移效用
articles.abstract_en: This paper proves the existence of a non‐stationary equilibrium in the canonical search‐and‐matching model with heterogeneous agents. Non‐stationarity entails that the number and characteristics of unmatched agents evolve endogenously over time. An equilibrium exists under minimal regularity conditions and for both paradigms considered in the literature: transferable and nontransferable utility. To address potential discontinuities in match opportunities across types, our analysis introduces a generalized Schauder fixed‐point theorem suitable for models with discontinuous value functions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文证明了具有异质性主体的经典搜索匹配模型中非平稳均衡的存在性。非平稳性意味着未匹配主体的数量及其特征随时间内生演化。在文献所考虑的两种范式下——可转移效用与不可转移效用——均衡均在最小正则条件下存在。为处理不同类型之间匹配机会的潜在不连续性，本文的分析引入了一种适用于具有不连续值函数模型的广义Schauder不动点定理。

articles.title_en: Nonrecursive dynamic incentives: A rate of convergence approach
articles.title_cn: 非递归动态激励：一种收敛速度方法
articles.abstract_en: In repeated principal‐agent problems and games, more outcomes are implementable when performance signals are privately observed by a principal or mediator with commitment power than when the same signals are publicly observed and form the basis of a recursive equilibrium. We investigate the gains from nonrecursive equilibria (e.g., “review strategies”) based on privately observed signals. Under a pairwise identification condition, we find that the gains from nonrecursive equilibria are “small”: their inefficiency is of the same 1 − δ power order as that of recursive equilibria. Thus, while private strategies or monitoring can outperform public ones for a fixed discount factor, they cannot accelerate the power rate of convergence to the efficient payoff frontier when the folk theorem holds. An implication is that the gains from withholding performance feedback from agents are small when the parties are patient.
articles.abstract_cn: 在重复委托-代理问题和博弈中，当绩效信号由具有承诺权的委托人或者中介私下观察时，可实施的结果比相同信号被公开观察并构成递归均衡基础时更多。我们研究了基于私下观察信号的非递归均衡（例如，“审查策略”）所带来的收益。在成对识别条件下，我们发现非递归均衡的收益是“小的”：其无效率与递归均衡具有相同的1 − δ 幂阶。因此，虽然私人策略或监控在固定贴现因子下可以优于公开策略，但当民间定理成立时，它们无法加速收敛到有效收益边界的幂速率。一个含义是，当各方有耐心时，不向代理人反馈绩效信息的收益是小的。
